title: The Monk Who Wanted Cash
content:
He listened to a central bank promise cash.

Maximum privacy. Structurally incapable of linking a person to a payment. Offline, only payer and payee. Online, the banks still see it. For AML. Target 2029, alongside cash. Civil society said the guarantees relied too heavily on institutional assurances rather than technical enforcement.

He poured the tea. A ledger, he thought, cannot be cash by promising not to look.
